title: Bodywork Kneaded

services.name: Corporate Massage
services.desc: What better way to promote corporate wellness or show some employee or volunteer appreciation than by treating your hard working staff to a chair massage? Offering employees or volunteers a 10 - 20 minute chair massage is a reward they will all appreciate and a great way to get some positive energy flowing! Chair Massage is performed in a 5’x5’designated area for each therapist. Our licensed and insured practitioner(s) will travel to your location with all necessary equipment. No oils are used for chair massage. Your associates remain fully clothed. Music can be provided if requested at time of scheduling. On average a therapist can see 2-4 people per hour depending on the length of time

gap: Prices, hours and eligibility are not copied here yet. We will ask when you request.
blurb: You will be properly covered with a sheet and blanket. As each part of your body is being massaged, it is uncovered. The therapist will leave the room while you undress and redress. You may undress to your comfort level, by choosing to be unclothed, or to wear your underclothes.
